record.question: Which of the following jurisdictions of the Supreme Court allows it to settle disputes between the centre and the state and amongst states?
record.explanation: Answer B: Original. Article 131 is the Supreme Court’s original jurisdiction for specified Centre–State and inter-State disputes. Reference: https://www.indiacode.nic.in/bitstream/123456789/10230/1/constitution_of_india.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: October 2025 examination (cover page); answer time-sensitive wording as of then.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
